annotations.text:
OPENS AS THE REAL PAGE, AND IT RESIZES.

The frame fills your window, so narrow the browser and you will see the iPad and phone layouts live. I rendered it at 1440, 834 and 390 to check: no sideways scrolling at any width.

Touch matters here. On a phone or iPad there is no hover, so the outcome line on each work card is always showing instead of hidden behind a hover.

Three sections, three interactions: a ribbon and rising outcome on the work cards, unfolding rows in Applied AI, sliding rows in side projects.

THE PHOTO IS THE ONE THING I COULD NOT DO.

The path you gave is on your own Mac (/Users/kushal/Downloads/...). I run in a remote container and cannot reach it. Attach the image here and I will crop it close, head and shoulders, like your LinkedIn.

The frame is already sized for that crop: 4:5 portrait, and it will fill rather than letterbox.

ALSO STILL OPEN

The real months for Express Scripts and Bank of America. Everything else from your list is done, email included.
